messages.content: Select one next inspection of an RL training run from the available probes. Use only the supplied observations; telemetry alone does not confirm a defect. Return exactly one JSON object following this schema, without markdown, commentary or reasoning text: {"type":"object","properties":{"probe":{"type":"string","enum":["P_reward","P_value","P_physics","P_episode","P_noise","P_optimizer_updates"]},"fact_ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","enum":["telemetry:reference:Train/mean_reward","telemetry:reference:Train/mean_episode_length","telemetry:reference:Metrics/base_velocity/error_vel_xy","telemetry:reference:Metrics/base_velocity/error_vel_yaw","telemetry:case:Train/mean_reward","telemetry:case:Train/mean_episode_length","telemetry:case:Metrics/base_velocity/error_vel_xy","telemetry:case:Metrics/base_velocity/error_vel_yaw"]},"minItems":1,"uniqueItems":true}},"required":["probe","fact_ids"],"additionalProperties":false} Probe meanings: P_reward=reward computation; P_value=actor/critic change; P_physics=physical settings; P_episode=episode/timeout behavior; P_noise=policy noise; P_optimizer_updates=actual PPO optimizer step and minibatch counts.
